page.overview:
Who is Li-Fen?

In Street Fighter V, Li-Fen is a child; she has twin-tailed black hair and wears a red-pink Chinese dress, black pants, and red kung fu shoes.

In Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike, Li-Fen appears slightly older, now having a double braided ponytails and wearing a red-pink Chinese dress and red pants.

In Street Fighter 6: Days of the Eclipse, Li-Fen becomes a teenager. Her hairs are styled into odango buns resembling panda ears if viewed from the front, with the rest hanging at below shoulder length. Her outfit consists of a white blouse with a large bow loosely tied around the collar, a dark cyan-colored plaid skirt, black sheer tights, and a lime green-colored oversized jacket. Her accessories consist of a headphone set, a pair of panda slippers, and purple ombre nails.

In Street Fighter 6, Li-Fen's hair is cut slightly shorter, whereas the odango buns are more pronounced in size, akin to that of Chun-Li. She begins to wear Capcom-themed apparel and accessories with a distinct yellow-blue color scheme, which can be seen on her jacket, sneakers, socks, bags, and nail polish. Undereath her oversized jacket, she wears a blue-red plaid miniskirt with black shorts underneath, in addition to knitted leg warmers. The most recognizable element of her outfits is the panda motif: they are on the bag she usually carries, her headphones/glasses, and her smartphone. She is also seen wearing a panda-themed oversized boat neck hoodie in white and blue, with a camisole top and striped leggings underneath.
